title: Organization config snapshot — STEP 12 multi-institute gate parameterization
description: Shape of the per-job organization-config snapshot: GenerationJob -> CourseProject.OrganizationId -> Organization, resolved and serialized once at enqueue time (immutable per job — re-resolving a live Organization row mid-job would break reproducibility if it changed between attempts). This is independent of contracts/generation-job/*.schema.json's own contractVersion. Two consumers read it: academy-brain's brand-palette/arabic-ratio/trainer-boundary gates (via --org-config <path>, a file written from the brandPalette/languagePolicy/boundaryTerms subset — see swarm/org_config.py) and CourseDeveloper.Infrastructure's NBLM-prompt-preflight fact-corrector/reevaluator (via the nblmPromptFields subset, read directly from GenerationJob.Payload in-process, no file needed).

schemaVersion.description: This snapshot schema's own version, independent of the generation-job request/result contractVersion.

organizationId.description: The Organization this snapshot was resolved from, for audit/debugging only — gates must not re-resolve it.

retired.description: The only set brand-palette.py's gate actually enforces — a color intersecting this set fails. 'approved' is carried through for parity with Organization.BrandPalette but is never enforced as an allowlist (see the ticket's brand_palette.py note).

forbiddenStrings.description: Additive institute-specific terms unioned on top of the trainer-boundary gate's mandatory TRAINER_MARKERS/TRAINER_PATTERNS baseline. An empty list here still runs the baseline — it never disables it.

nblmPromptFields.description: Folded in from STEP 11 Batch 3's follow-up review (2026-09-05): the same immutable snapshot NblmPromptPreflightRepair.TryCorrectAsync and its reevaluator render/check against, replacing their prior live ISessionRepository/IProjectRepository/IOrganizationRepository reads.

mascotCharacterName.description: Null means no mascot is configured for this organization — never fabricate a mascot clause.
